name: Madhanraj C
summary: I build responsive web apps with React, connect them to Java and Spring Boot services, and explore practical uses for agentic AI.

projects.name: Agentic AI Translator Bot
projects.description: A translation assistant that retrieves domain-specific glossary entries before generating a translation.
details: Implemented a ReAct agent with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to select tools and use their results during translation.
Built a FAISS-backed retrieval pipeline that supplies relevant glossary entries to the model for domain-specific translations.
Added tools for language detection and summarization and built a Streamlit interface for interactive translation.
Separated agent orchestration, tools, glossary ingestion, and retrieval so each part could evolve independently.

projects.name: Marketplace Backend API
projects.description: A Java and Spring Boot backend for a classifieds marketplace, covering accounts, listings and search.
details: Designed REST endpoints for user management, product listings and search.
Integrated MongoDB for flexible storage of listings and related data.
Added request validation, exception handling and interactive API documentation with Swagger.

roles.title: Software Engineer – Technology
details: Built and maintained Angular, React and Next.js applications, with reusable TypeScript components and responsive layouts.
Developed a real-time React booking dashboard that reduced service response time by 25%. Improved application load time by 40% through frontend optimizations, including lazy loading and memoization.
Integrated REST APIs with Spring Boot teams and contributed to prototypes for LLM tool calling and retrieval-augmented generation.
Improved issue resolution accuracy by 30% by analyzing historical data. Automated booking and scheduling anomaly detection, reducing customer complaints by 20%.
